uzo.purpose: Interrupts the page to ask for a decision before it happens: confirm, approve, reject with a reason. The page behind stays where it was.

instead.kialo: Who only informs does not interrupt, because a notice reads in the flow of the page; that is the avizo.

A form of more than one screen height is a page, because a dialog that scrolls hides its own actions: a formularo in a section of a pagxo; a form over several steps is still a person's decision (the boundary wizard of the formularo).

A layer that leaves the page usable is a popover, because a dialog takes the page until it is answered; the sxvebilo opens beside its trigger and closes on a click outside (Spec 014 ④ closes the boundary non-modal).

boundary.kialo: A panel that slides in from the edge is neither a dialog nor a popover, because it is a region of the page with its own flow (a Sxablono), not a question and not a layer beside a trigger; a person decides until the Sxablonoj come.
A dialog opens no second one, because two interruptions at once leave no page to return to.

containers.name: page
containers.kialo: A dialog belongs to the page it interrupts, because its decision returns the person there.

with.kialo: The actions of a dialog are its buttons, because a decision is taken by one of them: at most one with emphasis high.
A reason is text over several lines, because a reason is a sentence or two; the dialog shows the area itself.
The content of a dialog is running text where it explains the decision, because a person reads the reason before the buttons; the teksto sets it in the body role.
The heading of a dialog is a titolo at level 2, because the dialog is a document of its own and its heading names the decision (dialog-title-names-the-decision).
A short entry the decision needs stands in the content, because a field is one line.
A choice of one among many the decision needs stands in the content, because a list closes again.
A yes or no the decision needs stands in the content, because a check mark applies with the confirmation.
A notice stands in the content when the confirmation failed, because the person decides there what to do next; it takes no focus, the first field does.

case.de: Es soll nur etwas mitgeteilt werden, ohne dass jemand entscheiden muss.
case.en: Something is only to be told, without anyone having to decide.

case.de: Die Seite soll benutzbar bleiben, während die Ebene offen ist.
case.en: The page is to stay usable while the layer is open.

case.de: Das Formular ist länger als eine Bildschirmhöhe.
case.en: The form is longer than one screen height.

do.de: Lass die Überschrift die Entscheidung nennen und die Schaltflächen die möglichen Antworten.
do.en: Let the heading name the decision and the buttons the possible answers.

do.de: Wähle dismiss nach dem Zweck: free für einen Hinweis, guarded für ein Formular, explicit für eine Pflicht.
do.en: Choose dismiss by purpose: free for a hint, guarded for a form, explicit for a duty.

do.de: Setze reason required, wenn eine Ablehnung begründet werden muss; die Bestätigung bleibt gesperrt, bis Text da ist.
do.en: Set reason required when a rejection needs a reason; the confirmation stays locked until there is text.

dont.de: Aus einem Dialog einen zweiten öffnen.
dont.en: Open a second dialog from a dialog.

dont.de: Einen Dialog für eine bloße Mitteilung öffnen, die niemand beantworten muss.
dont.en: Open a dialog for a mere message nobody has to answer.

dont.de: Bei dismiss explicit eine Antwort weglassen, mit der die Person den Dialog wieder verlässt.
dont.en: Leave out an answer with which the person leaves the dialog again when dismiss is explicit.

action.de: Bricht ab und schließt den Dialog; bei dismiss explicit bleibt er offen, bis eine Antwort gewählt ist.
action.en: Cancels and closes the dialog; with dismiss explicit it stays open until an answer is chosen.

action.de: In einem einzeiligen Feld des Inhalts bestätigt die Taste, solange die Bestätigung nicht gesperrt ist.
action.en: In a one-line field of the content the key confirms, as long as the confirmation is not locked.
